en:
## New Features

- QQ Bot adapter: C2C/group/channel/DM support with WebSocket gateway, OAuth2 tokens, voice STT, and markdown messages
- WeChat iLink adapter: HTTP long-polling with AES-128-ECB encryption, QR login, media upload/download, and context persistence
- Model aggregations: combine same models from different providers into virtual entries with automatic routing or manual switching
- Tool call streaming input preview: real-time rendering of Write/Edit/Bash/Grep/Agent/Read tool inputs during execution
- IM gateway streaming output: progressive message editing for Telegram/Discord/Slack/Feishu
- IM gateway enhancements: rate limiting, idle session timeout, /model /list /search /switch commands, image support
- Gateway hot-reload: POST /reload with per-platform targeting
- Cascading compact: automatic multi-chunk summarization for conversations exceeding summary model context window
- Cross-session permission approval via quoted message references in IM

## Refactoring

- Major module decomposition (~12,000 lines net reduction): split settings, agent, narrator services, validators, frontend API, and WebSocket modules into focused files
- Shiki lazy-loading unified into single loader module, eliminating triple duplication
- Backend i18n consolidated into single entry point (server/lib/i18n.ts)
- Gateway config migrated from file-based to database storage
- Build script post-processing parallelized (signing/SHA-512/zstd patch)
- Settings page mobile UX: horizontal scroll replaced with drill-down navigation

## Bug Fixes

- Fix ToolCallCard memo missing _metadata and _resolvedModel field comparison causing stale renders
- Fix stream-consumer segment break loss during flushing with pendingFinalize flag
- Fix extractRawField incorrectly handling escaped quotes in gateway message parsing
- Fix ProcessSnapshot ps parsing preserving original whitespace in command arguments
- Fix admin.ts settings/saveSettings import accidentally removed
- Fix useMediaQuery initial render flicker on settings page
- Add gateway_session_mappings.app_user_id index for notification query performance
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- QQ Bot 适配器：支持 C2C/群聊/频道/DM，WebSocket 网关，OAuth2 令牌管理，语音 STT，Markdown 消息
- 微信 iLink 适配器：HTTP 长轮询 + AES-128-ECB 加密，扫码登录，媒体上传下载，会话恢复
- 模型聚合：将不同供应商的同一模型聚合为虚拟条目，支持自动路由或手动切换
- 工具调用流式输入预览：执行过程中实时渲染 Write/Edit/Bash/Grep/Agent/Read 等工具的输入内容
- IM 网关流式输出：Telegram/Discord/Slack/飞书支持渐进式消息编辑
- IM 网关增强：速率限制、空闲超时、/model /list /search /switch 命令、图片支持
- 网关热重载：POST /reload 支持按平台定向重载
- 级联压缩：对话超出摘要模型上下文窗口时自动分块渐进式压缩
- 跨会话权限审批：IM 中通过引用消息回复进行权限审批

## 重构

- 大规模模块拆分（净减少约 12,000 行）：settings、agent、narrator 服务、validators、前端 API、WebSocket 模块拆分为职责清晰的小文件
- Shiki 懒加载统一为单一加载模块，消除三处重复逻辑
- 后端国际化整合为统一入口（server/lib/i18n.ts）
- 网关配置从文件存储迁移到数据库
- 构建脚本后处理阶段并行化（签名/SHA-512/zstd patch）
- 设置页移动端体验优化：水平滚动改为 drill-down 导航

## 修复

- 修复 ToolCallCard memo 缺少 _metadata 和 _resolvedModel 字段比较导致渲染过期
- 修复流式消费器 flushing 期间 segment break 丢失问题
- 修复网关消息解析中 extractRawField 转义引号处理错误
- 修复 ProcessSnapshot ps 解析压缩命令参数中的连续空格
- 修复 admin.ts 中 settings/saveSettings 导入被误删
- 修复设置页 useMediaQuery 首次渲染闪烁
- 新增 gateway_session_mappings.app_user_id 索引优化通知查询性能
